questions.question: What FAA certificate is required to fly a drone commercially in the United States?
questions.questionHtml: What FAA certificate is required to fly a drone commercially in the United States?

answers.text: No certificate is required for small drones
answers.textHtml: No certificate is required for small drones

questions.feedback: The FAA requires a Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate for any commercial drone operation. It must be renewed every two years.
questions.feedbackHtml: The FAA requires a Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate for any commercial drone operation. It must be renewed every two years.

questions.question: Select ALL that apply: Which of the following are realistic expectations when starting a drone business?
questions.questionHtml: Select ALL that apply: Which of the following are realistic expectations when starting a drone business?

answers.text: You will spend most of your time on business tasks, not flying
answers.textHtml: You will spend most of your time on business tasks, not flying

answers.text: You will need upfront investment before seeing significant revenue
answers.textHtml: You will need upfront investment before seeing significant revenue

answers.text: You can expect to earn $300/hour immediately
You will need to differentiate yourself from existing competition
answers.textHtml: You will need to differentiate yourself from existing competition

questions.feedback: Starting a drone business requires significant time on non-flying tasks, upfront investment, and competitive differentiation. High hourly rates are possible long-term but unlikely when starting out.

questions.question: What is the recommended approach for someone new to the drone industry who wants to start a business?
questions.questionHtml: What is the recommended approach for someone new to the drone industry who wants to start a business?

answers.text: Immediately invest in the most expensive equipment available
answers.textHtml: Immediately invest in the most expensive equipment available

answers.text: Start part-time while building experience and savings
answers.textHtml: Start part-time while building experience and savings

answers.text: Quit your current job immediately to focus full-time
answers.textHtml: Quit your current job immediately to focus full-time

answers.text: Skip the business plan and start marketing right away
answers.textHtml: Skip the business plan and start marketing right away

questions.feedback: Starting part-time reduces risk. It allows you to build experience, understand seasonal business cycles, and save money before committing full-time.

questions.questionHtml: Match each business plan section to its description:

answers.matchText: Projects revenue, expenses, and cash flow

questions.feedback: The Market Analysis identifies your target market and competition. The Financial Plan projects your revenue and expenses. The Executive Summary is a one-page overview that is written last but appears first.

questions.question: Why is it important to understand that the drone is often just a data collection tool?
questions.questionHtml: Why is it important to understand that the drone is often just a data collection tool?

answers.text: Because the real value is in processing and delivering actionable results to clients
answers.textHtml: Because the real value is in processing and delivering actionable results to clients

answers.text: Because flying is the easiest part of the job
answers.textHtml: Because flying is the easiest part of the job

answers.text: Because clients only care about raw footage
answers.textHtml: Because clients only care about raw footage

questions.feedback: Clients want actionable deliverables — inspection reports, edited videos, processed maps — not just raw data. The drone captures the data, but the real business value is in what you do with it afterward.
